items.rationale: The established cause is external surface flooding under §2.5, and no group (c2) cover is shown. §3.6.2(b) bars the labour; the conditional estimate is 12 hours at €90 gross.
§3.6.2(f) bars all journey charges for this flood. If the event were covered, §7.1.7(g) would allow only one journey charge, estimated at €75 gross.

§3.6.2(d) bars pumping equipment for this flood. Even for an insured event, §§4.3(d) and 5.2.2 would bar separate reimbursement for working equipment billed alongside extraction; €350 is a nominal gross procurement estimate.
§3.6.2(d) bars this equipment charge, and §5.2.2 independently prevents separate payment for a pump used in the billed extraction. The €110 gross figure is a nominal short-term equipment charge.

§§3.6.2(d) and 5.1 bar mitigation costs for this uninsured flood despite the need for prompt pumping. The conditional €550 gross estimate includes labour and pumping equipment as one measure under §5.2.2.
§3.6.2(c) bars installed materials for this uninsured flood. The conditional €150 gross estimate covers only materials incorporated into the affected circuits under §7.1.7(c).

items.description: Boiler, flue and storage tank renewal
items.rationale: Fixed heating plant is insured property under §4.2.2, but §3.6.2(a) bars replacement after this uninsured flood. The conditional €12,000 gross estimate is for like-for-like installed renewal under §7.1.1(c), excluding separately listed adaptation and disposal.

§3.6.2(a) expressly bars adaptation work associated with replacement after this uninsured flood. The conditional €650 gross estimate is limited to immediately adjoining connections needed for a like-for-like replacement under §7.1.7(d).
§3.6.2(e) bars removal and disposal for this uninsured flood. The conditional €450 gross estimate allows for hauling out and disposing of the old boiler, flue and tank under §5.2.1.
§3.6.2(f) bars this charge, and §7.1.8(d) would also bar it as a second journey charge if the first were allowed. The nominal gross estimate for a single attendance is €75.
